caption: The drawing depicts a square pattern made up of geometric shapes and a woven appearance, composed of alternating colors including reddish-brown, blue, and cream. The design is divided into a grid of nine major sections: the four corners each feature a square filled with a blue and reddish-brown checkered and plaid pattern framed by blue borders, the center consists of a checkerboard and small geometric motif in blue and cream, and the four sections in between are populated by vertical cream and reddish-brown zigzag lines bordered with details of blue and reddish-brown. Smaller blue square accents and grid lines run horizontally and vertically across the composition, unifying the overall pattern. The background is plain and cream-colored, with no additional objects or patterns outside the main square motif. There is a small, round, red stamp or signature in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Coverlet
